items.title: Spain train collision kills at least 68 after control error
items.snippet: A Spain train collision near Urda, in Toledo province, killed at least 68 people on 28 October 2026, according to the regional government of Castilla-La Mancha. The Associated Press reported that another 58 people were receiving hospital treatment. The crash involved two high-speed trains travelling from Madrid towards Seville, prompting an emergency response and suspending services on the affected corridor.

items.title: Vrbo Launches Reserve Now, Pay Later — With a Twist on Airbnb’s Approach
items.snippet: Skift Take: Paying nothing up-front has been one of Airbnb's clearest growth levers. Vrbo's version of Reserve Now, Pay Later seems more host-friendly, but it gives guests less flexibility in when they can cancel without penalty. Will that weaken the tailwinds for Vrbo that Airbnb got?

items.title: True Palate Hospitality Targets 50 Outlets Across Its Restaurant Portfolio by 2030
items.snippet: True Palate Hospitality, the hospitality company behind One8 Commune, Neuma and Pincode, is targeting a portfolio of 50 outlets and revenue of ₹900–1,000 crore over the next five years, by 2030. The company currently operates approximately 20–22 outlets across India and international markets.

items.title: Your Operator Is a Staffing Company With a Logo. The VCs Just Figured It Out.
items.snippet: Thayer Ventures co-founder Chris shares lessons from travel tech investing: why AI will reshape hotel distribution, why 2027 is the inflection point for agentic operations, and why the hotel operating model is overdue for reinvention.

items.title: Can Pakistan International Airlines Recapture Its Former Glory?
items.snippet: Once among Asia’s most admired airlines, Pakistan International Airlines faces a difficult comeback under private ownership, confronting decades of financial troubles, political interference, fleet challenges and a troubled leadership search.

items.title: Sterling ONE wins national B2B technology award as transactions rise 34%
items.snippet: Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited (SHRL) has won the ‘Smart Tech Enabled Platform of the Year 2026 – B2B’ award for Sterling ONE, its proprietary digital distribution platform, at the Indian Travel & Technology Summit & Awards 2026 in Delhi. The recognition comes as Sterling’s partner-led distribution business gains traction.

items.title: India is ready for global restaurant brands, but the bigger opportunity lies in taking Indian cuisine worldwide: Zorawar Kalra
items.snippet: Speaking at the 2nd edition of ET FoodXP 2026, Zorawar Kalra, Founder & MD, Massive Restaurants, and Yangdup Lama, Celebrity Bartender & Owner, Sidecar, discussed India's growing appeal to international restaurant and bar brands.

items.title: ATOAI to host 2026 Convention in Jim Corbett, Uttarakhand from Dec 13-16
items.snippet: The Adventure Tour Operators’ Association of India (ATOAI), in collaboration with the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, and the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board, will host its 18th Annual Adventure Convention at Jim Corbett National Park, Uttarakhand, from December 13 to 16, 2026.

items.title: ‘Small operational details can have a big impact’ : Sandip Satange
items.snippet: As BKC continues to strengthen its position as a key business and hospitality hub in Mumbai, hotels are balancing strong corporate demand with opportunities across MICE, events and leisure. At ibis Mumbai BKC, General Manager, Sandip Satange is focused on driving occupancy, ADR and profitability while strengthening guest experience and operational efficiency.

items.title: It’s a wrap! THINC Sri Lanka & Maldives
items.snippet: It’s a wrap! THINC Sri Lanka & Maldives by Hotelivate | Oct 27, 2026 After a six-year hiatus, Hotelivate-Savills returned to Colombo for the fourth edition of the Tourism Hotel Investment & Networking Conference (THINC). The last edition of the conference was held in 2019, making this year's gathering particularly significant for the region's hospitality industry.
